Mind-controlled slave |height = |eye color = |hair color = |TV actor =[[Jared Bankens]] |stunt double= }} '''Nick the Prick''' is a member of the [[Great Khans]] in [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]], leading the group that occupies the town of [[Novac]]. ==Background== At some point prior to 2296, Nick the Prick led his group of Great Khans to capture Novac as their stronghold in the [[Mojave Wasteland]], with the [[Dino Dee-lite Motel]] as their base that they plastered with the group's flags and graffiti. No explanation is given of the original inhabitants' fate nor whether it was Nick's Great Khans that were ultimately responsible. Nick's group in Novac was decimated by [[the Ghoul]], though Nick managed to survive. However, he was later captured by [[Hank MacLean]] and brainwashed into a loyal [[Vault-Tec Corporation|Vault-Tec]] [[X-Branch office worker|office worker]] at the [[Las Vegas management Vault]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Innovator]]=== During their journey through the Mojave, [[Lucy MacLean]] and [[the Ghoul]] arrive in Novac and discover the occupying Khans. Seeking to gain supplies, they stage the Ghoul's capture for the bounty the Khans had placed on him long ago. Nick makes a show of the Ghoul's execution, claiming that it is justice for how he has been "tormenting" them for years. When Lucy reveals herself and tries to offer diplomatic options to the Khans, Nick only plays along to find out what she has planned before inciting his men to attack, saying whoever kills her gets the privilege of eating [[CX404|her dog]]. During the ensuing firefight, Lucy attempts to neutralize the raiders with non-lethal shots, but the Ghoul preempts her by killing everyone that tried to attack him. Nick himself is shot in the leg by Lucy, after which he staggers to cover behind the makeshift noose and is not seen afterwards. ===[[The Other Player]]=== Nick is revealed to have survived his gang's encounter with Lucy and the Ghoul, but having subsequently been captured by [[Hank MacLean]]. He was implanted with a [[brain-computer interface chip]], turning him into a brainwashed, demure office worker, given a haircut and a clean shave. He was then placed on the staff of the assembly line for producing more chips in the Las Vegas management Vault. When Lucy captures Hank, intending to return to [[Vault 33]] to make him face justice, she tells all the staff that they are free to go back to the surface. However, all of them decline, with Nick saying it is safer for them inside the facility. ==Personality== What is shown of him among the Great Khans indicates that Nick's leadership is more to do with being the most outspoken, as he proves to be a lousy shot, but he whips his men into a battle frenzy once they start hanging the Ghoul and joins in the defense when Lucy attacks. However, he is ultimately shown to be a coward, as he seemingly either fled from Novac or played dead after he is wounded and the rest of his men are killed off. After escaping the massacre of his men and being captured and chipped by Hank MacLean, Nick's surly characteristics have disappeared and turned him into a model Vault-Tec employee happily working away to further Hank's plans. When Lucy tells the staff they can leave the facility, the mind-controlled Nick says he likes being in the safety of the underground building. ==Appearances== Nick the Prick appears only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|9=201|14=206}} ==Gallery== FOTV S2E1 Novac 0004.png|Nick about to hang the Ghoul Nick the Prick The Other Player VTuf.png|Nick in the Las Vegas management Vault, as an office worker {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Great Khan characters]] [[ru:Ник-подонок]]
